verdict.rationale: Publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair ask for a vector database with client APIs, so the axis applies. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and nothing in the docs mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are different capabilities and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
